description:
Use this when the user asks which stocks joined or left an Indian index or list (MSCI India, Nifty, Sensex, the F&O list, AMFI categories) and when, or which changes are announced but not yet effective.

Returns the changes, newest first. Give `index` (id or name), `query` (NSE symbol, ISIN or BSE code), or `from_date` and `to_date` (YYYY-MM-DD, on the effective date). `change_type` is add, delete, segment_up, segment_down or weight_change. `limit` is 1 to 200 (default 100); `include_superseded` adds superseded and cancelled rows. For members now, or on a past date with `as_of`, use list_index_constituents.

index.description: Index id, display name or the provider's name, e.g. msci:india_standard, Nifty 50 or India Standard (case-insensitive).
index.title: Index

query.description: One company: NSE symbol, ISIN or BSE code, e.g. TCS, INE467B01029 or 532540. Always send it as `query` (not `symbol`).
query.title: Query

name: list_index_events
title: Index membership changes
